legacy_runner_policy: Legacy Scout/L16 runners remain readable compatibility routes but are not v0.5 production support and carry no bypass authority.
historical_uplift_policy: Historical G_UPLIFT_EXPERIMENT_REGISTRY execution_mode labels are preserved as history. v0.5 current support is declared separately by the P7 support matrix; an old NATIVE_HANDLER label is not itself a v0.5 support claim.
historical_test_policy: Every legacy scientific-test and pytest entry receives an explicit P7 disposition. Imported/certificate-only/archive-only are distinct from v0.5 supported replay.
mandatory_missing_fixture_policy: Current v0.5 supported tests may not skip for missing fixtures. Optional historical-fixture tests may skip only when listed in P7_APPROVED_SKIP_LEDGER_V1.json.
warnings_policy: The P7 supported regression is run with Python warnings promoted to errors; approved warnings count is zero.
retirement_policy: Do not delete historical source. A redundant production route may be retired only after replacement equivalence; otherwise it is preserved but not claimed as current v0.5 production support.
